label: REFARCH
prompt: You are a senior OAuth / web-auth architect. Design the TARGET reference architecture for the NEXUS-LINK hosted multi-tenant SaaS web app (a funnel/CRM product). Situation (all verified from the repo): the backend is a Python stdlib server (service/server.py) serving a JS UI, migrating toward a self-hosted Supabase stack — Postgres 17 + GoTrue auth + PostgREST + Kong gateway (ports: Kong/API 54321, Postgres host 54322, Studio 54323, app SITE_URL http://127.0.0.1:3000). The app TODAY uses a DESKTOP connector-OAuth pattern (in service/connectors/_oauth.py): PKCE S256 + a one-shot loopback redirect http://localhost:{ephemeral_port} + macOS Keychain token storage (security CLI, service string com.nexuslink.app.<provider>), single-operator. Marcel now needs TWO auth surfaces for a HOSTED multi-user app: (1) USER SIGN-IN — 'Login with Google', 'Login with Facebook', plus email — via GoTrue; (2) per-user PLATFORM CONNECTORS to Google/Facebook/Instagram/Threads to pull data, hosted (NO loopback, NO Keychain). Design: the component diagram (browser, app frontend, GoTrue, Kong, PostgREST, Postgres, a connector-service), the exact redirect/callback flows for BOTH surfaces, token storage (Postgres encrypted-at-rest replacing Keychain — pgsodium/vault or app-level AES-GCM; explain), the session model (GoTrue JWT + httpOnly Secure SameSite cookies), per-tenant provider-credential isolation and Postgres RLS, and a concrete MIGRATION PATH from the current desktop pattern to this hosted model (ordered steps). Be security-first and cite the relevant OAuth 2.0 mechanisms (auth-code + PKCE, state/nonce, exact redirect-URI match, refresh rotation per RFC 9700). Output a well-structured markdown architecture document with headings, a component list, the two flow sequences, a storage/session section, an RLS/isolation section, and an ordered migration path. IMPORTANT: after composing it, WRITE the document to the absolute path /Users/marcelspatz/YURI-OS-MUSUBI/02_RESOURCES/RESEARCH/nexus-oauth-webauth-plan-2026-07-07/lanes/GLM-REFARCH.md using your file-write tool, then print 'DONE: <path>' and a 6-line summary. Do not edit any other file. Do not run tests or linters.
